Valmont depot: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, certified June 2023 (renewal due June 2028). Operations lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. Average 410 daily departures, winter peak 530; 1.8% cancellations. Night shift understaffed.

Key issues: Feb 2025 brake line failure grounded nine vehicles four days, cause unknown; brake checks every 6,000 km. Sept 2024 fuel card cloning lost €4,200. May 2026 double-published roster left two shifts uncovered.

Rules: fuel card second approval above €200; parts above €500 need two quotes; route changes need seven days' notice; incidents filed within 24 hours; roster needs one named publisher.

Electrification study approved but unfunded; second charging bay due Q3. Old ticketing terminals on three routes.
